verdict.rationale: RustDesk documents P2P connections and lets you run your own ID/rendezvous and relay servers, which removes the vendor server from the path. A long-time user confirms it works with "no account" on their own lookup/relay server. However, nothing in the pack documents finding hosts on the local network, and one user reports it required a rendezvous/relay server and could not connect directly by IP, so some server is still in between. Missing for 10: documented LAN host discovery, direct serverless/IP connection on the local network, first-party confirmation that no account is needed.

support.subject: As a power user, my devices find the host on the local network and connect without an account or a vendor server in between

citations.quote: Self-hosted ID/rendezvous and relay servers with Server OSS or Server Pro; clients connect peer to peer when they can and fall back to your relay.
P2P connection with end-to-end encryption based on NaCl.
You can use our rendezvous/relay server, set up your own, or write your own rendezvous/relay server.
no ports to open, no VPN, no account, no vendor lock-in. Has used it for years with their own lookup/relay server
